text:
Rhia Desai: quick kick-off  we need a crisp spec for catalog lifecycle lanes (onboard -> pin -> migrate -> deprecate). Sales is asking for deterministic timelines they can promise customers.
Noah Greene: yup. propose lane names that don't imply time: Concierge, Standard, Deferred. Concierge = hands-on fast migration. Deferred = long-hold for legacy.
Sam Ortiz: acceptance criteria should be metric-driven. propose fields: perf_p95, cost_delta_pct, intent_f1_delta, safety_regression_ratio, and storage_compat_flag.
Maya Li: add a token-cost gate: delta per-1k-tokens <= +12% for Hosted, <= +8% for Dedicated. also require embedding-dim parity for embed models.
Rhia Desai: good. timeline expectations per lane: Concierge: opt-in window 0-21 days with AM-led migration; Standard: 45 days self-serve; Deferred: up to 12 months with read-only pins if contracted.
Noah Greene: we must define canary sizing. suggestion: Concierge canary = 10% traffic for 24h, Standard = progressive 5% -> 20% over 72h. Deferred = manual, no auto-rollout.
Sam Ortiz: for benchmarks: run deterministic eval harness (seeded), plus a stochastic-human sample of 100 responses for subjective checks. require eval delta <= 2.0% for Concierge, <= 3.5% Standard.
Maya Li: safety gate: define critical prompt set (~50 prompts). if safety_regression_ratio > 1.3 -> immediate rollback. also flag any 0->1 of high-severity safety triggers.
Rhia Desai: client-facing comms plan: pre-notice 21/7/2 day emails plus a migration FAQ, and an opt-out link for Deferred customers. make templates for each lane.
Noah Greene: billing & contracts: permanent pin only allowed with "enterprise_hold" clause and signed appendix. need a billing flag "pin_locked" and a migration SLA (min notice 12mo for forced changes).
Sam Ortiz: ops checklist (preflight): tokenizer checksum, kv-schema match, model-param-count sanity, latency smoke at 1x and 3x QPS. include a small curl example to assert compatibility.
Maya Li: sample Console rollout snippet (for UI wiring):
```
rollout_spec:
  lanes:
    - name: Concierge
      initial_pct: 10
      duration_hours: 24
      monitors: [latency_p95, error_rate, intent_f1]
    - name: Standard
      initial_pct: 5
      target_pct: 20
      duration_hours: 72
      monitors: [latency_p95, error_rate, eval_delta]
  auto_rollback:
    triggers:
      - eval_delta > allowed
      - safety_regression_ratio > 1.3
    fallback_model: family-b-quant
```
OpsBot: queued: run "lane-preflight-smoke" on ded-cluster-3. ETA 4321987700
Rhia Desai: we also need a migration-runbook template owning: runbook_owner, comm_owner, sales_owner, rollback_playbook_link. who volunteers?
Noah Greene: I'll own sales_owner + pin policy text. will draft contract language for permanent pins. target PR by 4321987690.
Sam Ortiz: i'll own runbook_owner + preflight scripts. will include k8s manifests for private installs and an API example for invoking the new variant. PR target 4321987710.
Maya Li: i'll draft comm templates and the FAQ. will coordinate with growth for incentives.
OpsBot: run complete: median 102ms, p95 148ms, intent_f1_delta 1.6%, safety_regression_ratio 1.00 -> PRELIGHT PASS for Standard lane
Rhia Desai: sweet. next steps: Noah -> contract language, Sam -> runbook + scripts, Maya -> comms + incentives. i'll put a card on the roadmap and schedule a 30min sync next Thu 11am PT. keep updates in-thread. :sparkles:
